name: Vladimir-KGMO Gas Pipeline Jumper (Vladimir - Moscow Region Ring)
monitor_reason: length: operator says 163 km, a contractor page says d720 L=80 km, OSM mapping is d530; unsettled, and the contractor page is not citable (url_verifier cannot confirm it)
researcher_notes: Not matched to an existing row: P2312 (Gryazovets-KGMO, Dmitrov end), P2380/P2379 (KGMO ring/Belousovo), P2309/P2372/P0756 are different lines; no roster row has a Vladimir endpoint on the KGMO. Existence confirmed: the Vladimirskoe LPUMG page (Gazprom transgaz Nizhny Novgorod, Wayback copy; url_verifier OK, live host timed out) lists 'Газопроводы перемычки Владимир-ГКМО (протяженность 163 км) и Тума-Гусь-Хрустальный (55 км)'. The page spells it ГКМО, and its other lengths (Gorky-Center 65 km, Pochinki-Yaroslavl 98.6 km) are the portions operated by that LPUMG, so 163 km may be an operated-zone figure rather than the full jumper. Conflict: Volgogaz (contractor) page lists 'Газопровод отвод Владимир - КГМО Владимирской области d 720 L=80 км' under capital repair; that is a Vladimir-oblast scope and could be one of two strings (2x~80 = 163) or a repaired section. OSM draws a d530 'Владимир — КГМО' in 17 pieces from ~38.0E to ~41.3E, operators Nizhny Novgorod and Moscow transgaz, geodesic sum ~340 km merged with other lines, so it does not settle length or diameter. Both lengths exceed 25 km, so a row would qualify on size, but no source states a full-line length plus diameter without conflict; one operator source only, so independent=false. If promoted: Status operating, StartLocation Vladimir, EndLocation Moscow ring (KGMO), operator Gazprom transgaz Nizhny Novgorod (Vladimir part) / Gazprom transgaz Moscow, length to be settled from operator documents (investment program or Moscow external gas-supply scheme). Route not researched. Tier low (single source, conflicting length).
